caption: A dim nighttime scene is dominated by a ribbed metal fence running diagonally across the lower frame. Near its top edge, a single intense white-blue light burns steadily, throwing a starburst lens flare and bright vertical streaks down the corrugated surface. Higher and slightly left, small yellow-orange lights sit on a thin post against the dark background. As the view shifts, the fence, bright light and yellow lights drift together across the image, first sliding right and then back left. The whole arrangement also sinks lower, and the diagonal fence line appears to flatten. The bright light and the yellow lights stay on throughout at roughly constant brightness, with no clear flicker, onset or offset.
